zh.name: MARKET INTELLIGENCE
zh.promise: 把一个立项问题，变成有来源的判断和下一轮验证。
zh.prompt: 研究 Merge＋社区方向。告诉我机会、风险，以及先验证什么。
zh.context: 公开研究案例 · Merge＋社区
beats: 给 Agent 项目方向、目标市场和你要做的决定。
商店观察、发行商披露、行业估算，各自保留口径。
品类份额扩大，头部仍然集中。
把市场判断，接到一轮能执行的验证。
结论、来源、未知项和下一步，留在同一份研究包里。
zh.close: 装上 Skill，直接对 Agent 说。
zh.case_note: 公开信号支持下一轮验证；立项由负责人决定。

en.name: MARKET INTELLIGENCE
en.promise: Turn a greenlight question into sourced findings and a practical next test.
en.prompt: Research Merge + community. Show the opportunity, the risks, and what to test first.
beats: Give your agent the idea, target market and decision you need to make.
Store observations, publisher disclosures and estimates keep their own definitions.
Category share is growing. Revenue is still concentrated.
Turn the market findings into a focused validation round.
Findings, sources, open questions and next steps travel together.
en.close: Install the Skill. Ask your agent.
en.case_note: Public signals support a further test. The owner makes the greenlight call.

zh.role: 游戏拆解与逆向分析师
zh.name: GAME REVERSE ANALYST
zh.promise: 从录屏、截图或授权工程开始，拆清规则、模块和资产关系。
zh.prompt: 拆解这个 2048 工程。说明合并规则在哪里，以及相关模块怎么分工。
zh.context: 2048 开源案例 · MIT · 静态分析
beats: 给 Agent 合法可用的资料，说明最想弄清的问题。
输入、规则、网格、表现和存储，各自找到负责的模块。
把看到的规则，追到具体实现位置。
文件位置、版本和分析回执，让另一位成员接着复核。
策划读规则，程序读模块，主美读资产观察与缺口。
zh.close: 装上 Skill，直接对 Agent 说。
zh.case_note: 规则示意来自固定版本源码；本案例未运行目标游戏。

en.name: GAME REVERSE ANALYST
en.promise: Start with footage, screenshots or authorized source. Map rules, modules and assets.
en.prompt: Analyze this 2048 source. Locate the merge rule and explain how the modules work together.
beats: Give your agent usable materials and the question you want answered.
Identify the modules behind input, rules, grid, display and storage.
Follow a visible rule back to its implementation.
File locations, version and receipts let another teammate review the work.
Designers get rules, engineers get modules, artists get asset observations and gaps.
en.close: Install the Skill. Ask your agent.
en.case_note: Rule illustration from pinned source. The target game was not executed.

zh.name: GAME PRODUCTION MANAGER
zh.promise: 把需求、决定和反馈，整理成团队或 Agent 能接手的工作包。
zh.prompt: 把这条社区订单拆成团队任务。说明谁来做、交什么、怎样验收。
zh.context: Merge＋社区 · 原创格式案例 · 草案
beats: 把原要求、已有决定和限制一起交给 Agent。
先写工作范围，再拆规则、资产状态和交接要求。
每个岗位拿到输入、产物、依赖和验收条件。
沿原任务追踪反馈，让相关岗位知道哪些内容要复核。
人或 Agent 都按同一份任务约定提交结果。
zh.close: 装上 Skill，直接对 Agent 说。
zh.case_note: 示例任务仍为 planned；实际制作由对应执行者完成。

en.name: GAME PRODUCTION MANAGER
en.promise: Turn requirements, decisions and feedback into work packages for people or agents.
en.prompt: Break this community order into team tasks. Say who owns each part, what to deliver and how to check it.
en.context: Merge + community · original format example · draft
beats: Give your agent the original brief, existing decisions and constraints.
Define scope, then separate rules, asset states and handoff requirements.
Each role gets inputs, outputs, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
Trace feedback through the tasks so each role knows what to review.
People and agents submit work against the same task agreement.
en.close: Install the Skill. Ask your agent.
en.case_note: Example tasks remain planned. Assigned executors do the production work.
